notes.title: Patch Notes - January 7, 2017
notes.content:
Thanks to user spiritofcat who pointed out 6 images that were inverted, I was able to fix the images and now they look much better!  The images impacted are listed below:

Track Workers
Norwegian Farmstead
Fast Friends
View Deck of Gunboat
View on Deck of Sidewheeler Hunchback
General Grant's Council of War

I also implemented a slide position indicator that shows you which slide number you are on.  This makes it easier to tell where you are in the slideshow and it is displayed just below the projection screen.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Nov. 30, 2016
notes.content:
-Refactored to work with latest version of SteamVR (1.1.1) and Unity (Camera rig changes broke the app)
-Removed some stereograms that were particularly hard to focus on

I have done some prototyping of dynamic loading of images to allow for easy extensions, but Unity takes an eternity to process new textures from disk, which makes it very challenging.  The reason the current form of the application works so efficiently is that everything is already loaded into texture files for easy loading.

In any case, for the time being I will keep trying to sort it out, but I am also planning to do some other improvements to the application in the meantime, such as adding new images.  ːgoldenː

notes.title: 5/5/2016 Update
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone for all of the great feedback! I  have implemented some of the most common suggestions in this update:

- Added an appropriate time period music soundtrack that plays in the background
- Added ability to mute/unmute music using touchpad on one of the controllers
- Added music symbol on trackpad of controller that is used to mute/unmute music
- Added date information for a large number of photos that is shown with the title
- Fixed a few images that looked bad due to cropping
- Fixed vertical position of gramophone
- Tweaked LOD distances for some objects
- Updated to latest version of SteamVR plugin for Unity
- Added ability to use Xbox controller bumper buttons to cycle through pictures

I hope everyone enjoys these improvements!  If you don't like the new music, you can easily mute by pressing the touchpad on the appropriate controller.  Let me know if you have any issues with this update!
